- PO metadata: we can populate project_code, BU_ID, cost_center, vendor_tax_id and remit_entity_id. We do ask that the PO number stays consistent across the invoice lifecycle.
- Invoice cadence: Redwood's default is monthly consolidated invoicing per bill-to legal entity. We can emit weekly sub-invoices if the PO includes an explicit multi-invoice flag and invoice_sequence_id (that matches your template).
- Net terms: ops note — Net60 is challenging for our cash cadence. Proposed compromise: Net45 standard; Net60 accepted only if HealthCord provides an advance commitment (minimum 6-month prepay or signed guarantee).
- Holdback: our legal prefers avoiding large holdbacks on new customers. Finance has authorized a 5% retainage for 90 days as a middle ground, rather than 10% for 60 days.
- Discount triggers: we can offer a tiered volume discount tied to annual committed spend (10% @ $250k ARR, 15% @ $750k ARR) — these require a signed order form and entity-level PO mapping.

Next steps I propose:
1) If HealthCord can sign to Net45 and accept a 5% 90-day retainage, we will generate SOW v1 and updated invoice examples.
